feature_name: Base and Robinhood flashloan deployment and receipt-bound execution

architecture.pattern: shared EVM pipeline with explicit chain profiles, artifact-verified deployment, durable per-signer budgets and exact-head execution
architecture.isolation_boundaries: Arbitrum and Sui retain separate identities; deployment does not grant trading admission; unknown submissions cannot be resent
execution_flow: verify roots, chain identity and compiled ABI
deploy and configure within persistent deployment cap
capture pinned pools and validate independent admission evidence
size and simulate exact calldata, verify latest head, sign and persist intent
submit once, reconcile actual fees, custody and canonical finality

inputs.snapshot: liquidity snapshot/analytics 4.0 with base/8453 or robinhood/4663 identity

outputs.deployment: DeploymentState: owner, manifestHash, durable transactions, artifact/runtime hashes, root configuration receipts
outputs.execution: schemas/evm-execution-receipt.schema.json plus canonical attempt journal and AcceptanceState

test_criteria: all five local EDGE proofs pass
Node and Rust suites pass; compiled ABI/event parity verified
portable split exact repayment, unauthorized callbacks and opening-fund preservation tested
real lender fork proofs explicitly enabled on both chains
real deployment receipts and runtime/owner/root readback verified
live acceptance requires one finalized receipt per chain with at least $10 net; pending status never counts as success
